hook: Ranking the most brutal skateboard fails from 5 to 1!

items.line: Number 5: Bailing off the board and tumbling straight down a full flight of stairs.
Number 4: The board flying out and sending him straight into a support pole.
Number 3: Wiping out completely on the mini ramp.
Number 2: Attempting a flip trick and slamming flat onto his back.
Number 1: Attempting a kickflip and eating pavement instantly!
